clue.text: Almost failing to evoke sentiment with energy

parts.note: to touch someone is to move them emotionally
and means together with
go is energy or drive, as in full of go

explanation.surface: Someone nearly flunking while trying to stir emotion with vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation that is precarious, with the result in doubt until the end, is said to be this idiom.

clue.text: Gloomy passion out of Arabia

indicators.note: out of says the abbreviation for Arabia is removed from the word for passion

parts.note: ardour is fervent passion

explanation.surface: A passionless mood after leaving Arabia, as if a traveller's romance had faded.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a stern, sullen, unsmiling manner is gloomy.

clue.text: Cat taking head off part of flower

indicators.note: taking head off says the first letter of the cat's name is dropped

parts.note: the big black cat of the leopard kind

explanation.surface: A cat decapitating a bloom, as cats do to garden flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: Botany: the pollen-bearing tip of a stamen is part of a flower.

clue.text: Egyptian jewel, namely, reflecting Egypt in general?

parts.note: SC, short for Latin scilicet, means namely
Egypt is, broadly speaking, an Arab country, so Egypt in general is Arab

explanation.surface: A jewel from Egypt that seems to sum up the whole country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reflecting' is only a link here (the piece reflects, i.e. represents, Egypt); nothing is reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancient Egyptians carved the sacred dung beetle as amulets and gems, so it is an Egyptian jewel.

clue.text: American director, awkward type, restricting improvisation, heading for Hollywood

indicators.note: restricting means hemming in, so the awkward type surrounds the improvisation

parts.note: a git is an annoying, awkward person (British slang)
a riff is an improvised musical phrase

indicators.note: heading for means the first letter of Hollywood

explanation.surface: A tricky US film-maker who keeps a lid on improvising on his way to Hollywood.
explanation.walkthrough: GIT is British slang for an unpleasant or awkward person.
explanation.definitionFit: D. W. Griffith was the pioneering US film-maker behind The Birth of a Nation.

clue.text: Attractive features in book to be without plot problems?

parts.note: to lack is to be without
plot holes are gaps in a story's logic

explanation.surface: A reader praising a novel's charms that has no flaws in its storyline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Attractive' means pulling in by gravity, not good-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: Collapsed stars whose gravity pulls in everything, even light, are features of space that attract.

clue.text: Judicious decisions ultimately will take time

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of decisions

parts.note: an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Sensible choices are slow to arrive, the clue sighs.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: wise and sound in judgement.

clue.text: Word from Paris to acknowledge musical genre

parts.note: mot is French for word
to own is to admit or acknowledge

explanation.surface: A French term recognising a style of music.
explanation.definitionFit: The Detroit record label gave its name to a style of soul and pop.

clue.text: Church canon, one of heavenly appearance?

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
a canon is a rule or law
an means one, as in an apple

explanation.surface: A cathedral clergyman with a saintly look.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a deep sky blue, the hue of the heavens.

clue.text: Good summer term, perhaps — school taking care of my expression of hesitation

indicators.note: taking care of means holding inside, so school wraps round the exclamation

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like my!
er is the sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: A school's summer term, managed with some hesitant remarks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Term' suggests a school term but means a word for a fine summer day.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British word for a very hot day, a welcome description in summer.

clue.text: Birds avoiding new data storage system

indicators.note: avoiding says the letter for new is left out of the birds

parts.note: small seed-eating songbirds

explanation.surface: Birds dodging a novel way of storing information.
explanation.definitionFit: Microfilm sheets holding miniaturised documents were a way of storing records.

clue.text: Judge to support dismissing British sailor

indicators.note: dismissing says the letter for British is sent away from the support word

parts.note: to back is to support

explanation.surface: A judge backing the dismissal of a British seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: A jack, or jack tar, is an old informal word for a seaman.

clue.text: A few entries onscreen and financier finally invested in essential fuels

parts.note: key means essential, as in a key point

indicators.note: invested in means placed inside, fitting the financier surface

parts.note: stokes means feeds a fire with fuel

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of financier

explanation.surface: A financier putting money into vital energy supplies, with a nod to computer entries.
explanation.definitionFit: Each press on a keyboard enters a character on the screen, so several of these are a few entries.

clue.text: Being critical is hard, generating friction around it

indicators.note: around it means the friction word goes round the pieces before it

parts.note: rubbing is friction
taken as written
H is an abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A comment that criticism is tough and causes friction.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British usage: to trash or disparage something is to be critical of it.

clue.text: Flower that may create autumn riots, nothing less

indicators.note: may create says the letters of autumn riots are made into something new, once the nothing is taken off

parts.note: the letters to rearrange
O is nothing, zero

explanation.surface: A bloom that causes wild disorder in autumn, minus anything left over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Less' says O (nothing) comes out of the letters of AUTUMN RIOTS before the rest is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a bright orange or yellow garden flower with round leaves.

clue.text: Subtly comic nonsense? It could bring down the house

definitions.text: It could bring down the house

parts.note: dry humour is understated and subtle
rot means nonsense

explanation.surface: Understated silly comedy that has the audience roaring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bring down the house' sounds like a theatre triumph but here means literally wrecking a building.
explanation.definitionFit: A fungus that decays timber can make a building literally collapse.

clue.text: Over with new ball possibly not from one of the big names?

definitions.text: not from one of the big names?

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over

indicators.note: possibly says the letters of new ball may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A cricket over bowled with a new ball, perhaps a cheap one.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is six balls and teams take a new ball periodically.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods sold under a shop's own brand rather than a famous manufacturer's are not from the big names.

clue.text: Openings on the radio for complete items

indicators.note: on the radio means heard rather than read, so a word is spoken

parts.note: holes are openings

explanation.surface: Gaps in a broadcast schedule filled with finished features.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that are entire and complete are full units.

clue.text: Potter character that could be total tonic

indicators.note: could be says the letters of total tonic may become something else

explanation.surface: A Harry Potter-style character who might be a drink of tonic.
explanation.definitionFit: One of Beatrix Potter's rabbits, sister of Peter Rabbit.

clue.text: Agree when in an ecstatic state?

parts.note: as means when, as in as I left
sent is old slang for enraptured, sent into ecstasy

explanation.surface: A question whether one consents in a moment of rapture.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to give consent is to agree.

clue.text: Garments easily disturbed

definitions.meaning: uniform clothing worn by servants or members of a guild
an informal adjective for irritable and peevish, as if bilious

explanation.surface: Clothes that are easily upset.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a servant's uniform; the other is liverish, meaning testy and irritable.

clue.text: Encourage sudden activity, being out of time

indicators.note: being out of says the letter for time is missing

parts.note: a spurt is a sudden burst of activity

explanation.surface: Prompting a burst of effort when the clock has run out.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to urge on or stimulate, as a rider does a horse.

clue.text: Cat's energy captured by an artist

indicators.note: captured by means held inside the surrounding pieces

parts.note: taken as written
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
go means energy

explanation.surface: A painter catching a lively cat on canvas.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a long-haired breed of domestic feline.

clue.text: 12 — number subsequently seen in mirror

indicators.note: seen in mirror says the word looks the same reflected

parts.note: on means later, as in from then on

explanation.surface: A digital clock's twelve, followed by its mirror image.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve o'clock in the day is midday.

clue.text: Some gutted by the truth's serious nature

indicators.note: gutted means the insides are removed, leaving only the outer letters of some

parts.note: verity means truth

explanation.surface: A sombre claim that the truth's gravity leaves some people devastated.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: sternness or gravity of character.

clue.text: Queen broadly happy about origin of cool musical genre

parts.note: R is short for Regina, Latin for queen

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the OK goes round the letter

parts.note: OK means broadly content, all right

indicators.note: origin of means the first letter of cool

explanation.surface: The Queen pretty pleased with a cool new style of music.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: the loud guitar-led popular style of music.

clue.text: Warnings formerly called back, as predicted

parts.note: fore is the golfer's warning shout

indicators.note: called back means read in reverse

parts.note: nee means formerly named, used before a maiden name

explanation.surface: Warnings issued long ago and recalled, just as predicted.
explanation.walkthrough: FORE is the shout golfers give to warn others of a ball in flight.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: anticipated or known in advance.

clue.text: Uproar in crowd in front of the Queen?

indicators.note: in front of means the crowd word comes before the Queen word

parts.note: a ruck is a crowd or tight bunch of people
us is the royal we, how a monarch might refer to herself

explanation.surface: A noisy scene in a crowd standing before the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that US is the royal 'we' used by a queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a noisy commotion or fracas.
